property_summary: After a Collect call when the caller's balance is exactly the MinSum and MinSum has been set to a non-zero value, the reference sets MinSum only once and then permanently, while the buggy SetMinSum allows MinSum to be changed after initialization, causing the Collect to succeed in the reference but revert in the buggy version due to the balance check failing after MinSum is increased.

After calling SetMinSum(1 ether), then Put with 1 ether, then Initialized, then SetMinSum(2 ether) which reverts in reference but succeeds in buggy version, then Collect(1 ether) with warp past lock time succeeds in reference (MinSum=1 ether, balance=1 ether) but fails in buggy version (MinSum=2 ether > balance)
